{
  "name": "ai-interviewer",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "scripts": {
    "build": "turbo build",
    "dev": "turbo dev",
    "lint": "turbo lint",
    "typecheck": "turbo typecheck",
    "test": "turbo test",
    "format": "prettier --write .",
    "format:check": "prettier --check .",
    "prepare": "husky"
  },
  "lint-staged": {
    "*.{js,jsx,ts,tsx}": [
      "eslint --fix",
      "prettier --write"
    ],
    "*.{json,css,md}": "prettier --write"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@eslint/js": "^9.39.2",
    "eslint": "^9.39.2",
    "eslint-plugin-react": "^7.37.5",
    "eslint-plugin-react-hooks": "^7.0.1",
    "@ai-interviewer/eslint-plugin-signature": "workspace:*",
    "husky": "^9.1.7",
    "lint-staged": "^16.2.7",
    "prettier": "^3.8.1",
    "turbo": "^2",
    "typescript-eslint": "^8.54.0"
  },
  "packageManager": "pnpm@10.28.2"
}

{
  "name": "@ai-interviewer/web",
  "version": "0.0.0",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "react-router dev",
    "build": "react-router build",
    "start": "react-router-serve ./build/server/index.js",
    "typecheck": "react-router typegen && tsc",
    "lint": "eslint .",
    "test": "vitest run",
    "test:watch": "vitest",
    "db:generate": "drizzle-kit generate",
    "db:migrate": "drizzle-kit migrate",
    "db:push": "drizzle-kit push",
    "db:studio": "drizzle-kit studio"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@ai-interviewer/shared": "workspace:*",
    "@neondatabase/serverless": "^1.0.2",
    "@react-router/node": "^7.2.0",
    "@react-router/serve": "^7.2.0",
    "arctic": "^3.7.0",
    "drizzle-orm": "^0.45.1",
    "effect": "^3.19.16",
    "isbot": "^5.1.17",
    "jose": "^6.1.3",
    "react": "^19.0.0",
    "react-dom": "^19.0.0",
    "react-router": "^7.2.0"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@react-router/dev": "^7.2.0",
    "@types/react": "^19.0.0",
    "@types/react-dom": "^19.0.0",
    "drizzle-kit": "^0.31.8",
    "typescript": "^5.7.0",
    "vite": "^6.0.0",
    "vitest": "^4.0.18"
  }
}
export * from "./mock-repositories.js";
